description: This Java class handles global exceptions in a Spring Boot web application, providing standardized error responses with appropriate HTTP status codes and error details.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller advice class that manages exceptions globally across the application, returning standardized API error responses.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NoSuchElementException, returning 404 Not Found with an ApiError object.

methods.name: handleSecurity
methods.description: Handles SecurityException, returning 403 Forbidden with an ApiError object.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles MethodArgumentNotValidException, aggregating validation errors and returning 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Handles multiple exceptions related to bad requests, returning 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: handleGeneral
methods.description: Handles generic exceptions, returning 500 Internal Server Error.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Helper method to construct an ApiError object and wrap it in a ResponseEntity with appropriate HTTP status.

calls: build(HttpStatus, String, String, Map<String, Object>, HttpServletRequest)
